name: Oh Ghee Inc
old_description: One of the most sacred healing foods with unparalleled therapeutic properties. A superfood for your entire body.
about:
Oh Ghee Inc is based in Bend, Oregon. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The business produces ghee—a clarified butter rendered from organic butter sourced from grass-fed cows—and extends that core ingredient into a line of skincare products, candles, and pet supplements. Manufacturing steps include butter clarification, blending with herbs for functional foods, formulation of topical creams, and candle pouring. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Oh Ghee sells directly to consumers through its website, targeting shoppers interested in specialty cooking fats, natural skin care, home fragrance, and pet nutrition. The company does not list industrial or wholesale customers.

The brand positions its ghee as a nutrient-dense superfood rich in omega-3 and omega-9 fatty acids, vitamins A, D, E, and K, antioxidants, amino acids, minerals, and enzymes. It claims the fat is free of inflammatory properties, highly digestible, and serves as a delivery medium for fat-soluble herbs to create therapeutic benefits. Skincare products are marketed for deep hydration and relief from dryness, while the pet line is said to support joint health, coat shine, and digestion.
